interpretation: Positive residual trait-to-port-record association after two imperfect worldwide GBIF reporting proxies; not evidence for sewage nutrient loading, local port enrichment, historical shipping, or butterfly colonization
warnings: Global GBIF reports include some observations near indexed ports, so controls and response overlap
Country count and total GBIF records are reporting and geography proxies, not independent native ranges or total biological occupancy
Only 182/687 non-native candidate host plants score on Germany-centered nutrient indicator and map to exact accepted GBIF names
Ellenberg N is vegetation site fertility affinity, not direct measured tissue or soil nitrogen
No covariates for invasive planting, port effort, trade, country-specific sample biases, soil nutrient, urban land cover, or historical vessel arrivals
Port sites 2019 geodata used as retrospective sampling anchors, not proof of historic shipping
Genus bootstrap descriptive interval is not an experiment-based causal interval; within-genus N test remained inconclusive at p=0.38
Separate source-locked same-island 78-port 35-island analysis did not confirm robust local port nutrient-affinity enrichment
